3b, 2023c). A nephron is the functional unit of the 
kidney and contains two parts: the glomerulus, which is a cluster of capillaries and nerve endings that cluster 
around its second part, the renal tubule. Urine created in the nephrons will pass into collecting ducts and flow to the 
minor calyxes, to the major calyxes, into the renal pelvis, and out of the kidney into the ureter.
